method.name: 24-control repository-owned hardening coverage
method.selection: Agent-authored requirements informed by pinned AFK patterns and existing Singleton Systems contracts.
method.weighting: One point per criterion. Present receives one; missing or not evidenced receives zero. Requirements have equal weight, not equal risk.
method.evidenceLevel: Current source readback plus passing local contract tests. No AFK execution or production integration audit.
limits: The percentage describes only this declared rubric.
Absence is bounded to .codex, config, lib, scripts, plugins/s-systems and docs/harness inspected in the source snapshot.
Codex app-managed lifecycle, all crash modes and live external adapters remain outside proven coverage.
Open-ended feature parity, multi-agent orchestration, daemons, notifications and alternative model runtimes are excluded by user scope.

criteria.requirement: Resolve one owner through canonical Cerebral routing

evidence.observation: Routing reads live rows and emits owner packets.

criteria.requirement: Fail closed when live registry rows are missing or unavailable

evidence.observation: RegistryUnavailable blocks; fixture verifies no local fallback.

criteria.requirement: Guard registered skill-script execution against canonical paths

evidence.observation: Registered skill roots and script targets are validated.

criteria.requirement: Record configured check exit results and output hashes

evidence.observation: Check records include exitCode, error, timedOut and output hashes.

criteria.requirement: Configure command deadlines and preserve timeout failure

evidence.observation: spawnSync timeout results leave the review incomplete; descendant teardown is assessed separately.

criteria.requirement: Bind review evidence to HEAD, active diff and contract

evidence.observation: Snapshot binds tracked and untracked content plus contract hashes.

criteria.requirement: Verify the chained review receipt hashes

evidence.observation: Tampered receipt chains are rejected.

criteria.requirement: Keep omitted unresolved findings open across passes

evidence.observation: Latest finding state is retained; omission does not resolve it.

criteria.requirement: Require declared passes and fresh human approval for accepted review

evidence.observation: Approval reads a fresh snapshot and rejects stale scope or missing passes.

criteria.requirement: Consult fresh bound evidence before a code-delivery completion claim

evidence.observation: Stop handles writing and Git-temp cleanup; no review or transaction completion lookup.

criteria.requirement: Bind individual finding resolution to a relevant check or readback result

evidence.observation: Proof and verification are required strings; the engine runs global configured checks.

criteria.requirement: Persist a prepared checkpoint before a mutation apply

evidence.observation: Checkpoint callback runs after preparation and before apply.

criteria.requirement: Recover uncertain writes by readback without automatic replay

evidence.observation: Uncertain outcomes resume at verification; changed uncertain input refuses replay.

criteria.requirement: Make verified duplicate delivery idempotent

evidence.observation: A matching verified delivery reuses its receipt without apply.

criteria.requirement: Invalidate dependent owners after an upstream input changes

evidence.observation: Dependency graph changes produce stale downstream states.

criteria.requirement: Write state atomically with restricted file permissions

evidence.observation: Temporary state is written with mode 0600 and renamed atomically; filesystem power-loss durability is untested.

criteria.requirement: Serialize state operations and recover dead local lock owners

evidence.observation: Lock contention and dead-owner takeover are tested; all crash permutations are not established.

criteria.requirement: Use retained storage as the default location for long-lived review state

evidence.observation: Default is OS temporary storage. Explicit --state already supports a retained path.

criteria.requirement: Associate repo-runner processes with task identity and deadline

evidence.observation: No common ownership registry found in the inspected harness; app-managed process lifecycle is outside the audit.

criteria.requirement: Stop only owned descendant processes on cancellation or teardown

evidence.observation: Command timeout exists; owned descendant/process-group teardown is not established by source or tests.

criteria.requirement: Verify exit and protect against PID reuse or unrelated-process cleanup

evidence.observation: Narrow Git-temp cleanup is separate. No shared repo-runner exit/identity proof was found.

criteria.requirement: Maintain deterministic regression cases for failure and recovery

evidence.observation: Failure fixtures and CodeRabbit-derived findings exist; automated incident capture is separate.

criteria.requirement: Scan existing redacted traces or receipts for recurring failure patterns on demand

evidence.observation: The inspected harness has check suites; no recurring-incident scanner was found.

criteria.requirement: Retain source provenance when converting selected incidents to regression cases

evidence.observation: Manual learned findings exist; no trace-to-case export contract with source checksum was found.

drift.previous: 25% was a judgment estimate with no denominator.
drift.current: The 24-control equal-point audit demonstrates 16 controls. Five are missing and three process controls are not evidenced.
drift.handoffRule: Report 66.7% demonstrated and 33.3% uncredited on this rubric. Do not call it measured full AFK parity or a security score.

drift.previous: User requested Jev for a more accurate score.
drift.current: The invoked skill excludes standalone ratings; its output selects among explicit priorities.
drift.handoffRule: Use ledger arithmetic for coverage. Jev probabilities are relative, uncalibrated choice scores.

drift.previous: Hash-bound review receipts can sound like universal completion enforcement.
drift.current: The review CLI enforces its own contract; Stop does not read that state.
drift.handoffRule: Reuse the existing engine in a narrowly scoped completion bridge. Preserve research and progress exits.

drift.previous: Resumable state can sound like persistent retention.
drift.current: Atomic checkpoint support exists; the review CLI defaults to an OS temporary path and accepts explicit --state.
drift.handoffRule: Fix the default retained path. Preserve explicit state paths and existing state; no automatic deletion or migration.

drift.previous: A required verification string can sound like verified execution.
drift.current: Configured global checks run; individual finding resolution is still supplied as text/status.
drift.handoffRule: H11 is a later additive review-contract change. Do not portray the existing global check runner as absent.

drift.previous: Lack of a shared repo registry can sound like no process cleanup anywhere.
drift.current: Command deadlines, narrow Git-temp cleanup and Codex-app process facilities exist; common repo-runner lifecycle evidence is absent.
drift.handoffRule: H19-H21 receive no audit credit. Inspect app integration before building a parallel process engine; preserve unrelated services.

drift.previous: Existing cases were described as synthetic.
drift.current: Deterministic recovery cases and seven CodeRabbit-derived finding fixtures already exist.
drift.handoffRule: Missing work is on-demand incident scanning and provenance export; retain existing fixtures.

drift.previous: Four passing checks could be read as complete repository or production health.
drift.current: Checks use fixture repositories and injected routing/runtime facts. Live Supabase, actual Stop delivery and live external writes were not exercised.
drift.handoffRule: Keep proof levels explicit. Prior unrelated Glaze typecheck failures and four existing dependency advisories are historical observations, not refreshed health results.

drift.current: The inspected source is pinned to 09cab784; its release commit identifies v5.302.1.
drift.handoffRule: Use the pinned source. Do not describe the earlier marketing version as current or silently switch to upstream HEAD.

drift.previous: Comparison sits beside an unfinished hosted video-review proposal.
drift.current: This task prepares evidence and creates a new implementation task. Hosted video review is still a separate pending source adapter.
drift.handoffRule: Implement only the first completion/retention slice in the new task. No AFK runtime, daemon, subagents, website, tracker, deployment, media or unrelated cleanup.

sources.qualification: Opt-in and autonomous mode only; correction cap fails open.
Owned jobs, deadlines and teardown inside AFK's own runtime.
Independent claim verification is a pattern reference; its delegated orchestration is excluded.
Detector reads traces. Source implements argument-hash fingerprinting when available.
Source fixture/provenance reference; no claim of full end-to-end replay parity.

jev.interpretation: Select completion enforcement with retained state as the first slice. Explanation is the reviewing agent's assessment, not Jev-generated reasoning.

firstImplementationSlice.authority: Jerami requested the research handoff first and then a new task.

limits: Only structured standalone code-delivery declarations are enforced.
Production desktop Stop delivery and human cancellation remain unverified.
Repository readiness and review approval do not prove release or external owner delivery.
